meta.name: using-skills
meta.description: Check and invoke available skills before starting work. Invoke at the start of any task to ensure relevant skills are loaded.

copy.tagline: 开工前自动装载所需技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望每次动手前技能都已就绪。
copy.tagline_en: Load the skills you need before starting any task.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want needed skills ready before you start.

howto.what: Claude 在开始任务前先检查可用技能,匹配并加载相关技能,随后按其流程规范执行;拿不准时也会调用,漏掉指南的成本更高。
howto.when: 任何任务开始时都会触发;例如写文档、审代码、画图时,会按需调用对应技能。

howto.what_en: Before starting any task, Claude checks available skills, matches and loads relevant ones, then follows their procedures and guidance. When uncertain, it still invokes, because missing relevant guidance is costlier.
howto.when_en: Triggers at the start of any task. For example, when writing docs, reviewing code, or creating diagrams, it loads the corresponding skill as needed.
